```{r}
library(metacheck)
```

## Process batch to XML files

```{r}

#Listing all the filepaths at which the pdf's are stored
pdf_files <- list.files(
  path = "Articles All Records/files",
  pattern = "\\.pdf$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Processing the batch of files to XML files
paper_testbatch <- convert(file_path = pdf_files,
                           save_path = "Articles All Records",
                           method = "grobid",
                           api_url = "https://grobid.hti.ieis.tue.nl", #if the server is not active take another one from list of active servers: https://www.scienceverse.org/metacheck/convert.json
                           crossref_lookup = FALSE)
```
